items.title: Anthropic opens Tokyo office
items.summary: Anthropic opens its first Asia-Pacific office in Tokyo and signs a Memorandum of Cooperation with the Japan AI Safety Institute.
items.summaryZh: 本文来自Anthropic News，围绕“Anthropic opens Tokyo office”介绍模型发布方面的最新进展，重点涉及Anthropic、模型发布。下方为系统保存的原文正文。
